defs.def: a flat, usually round, dish that you put food on 盘子；碟子

ex.s: It’s a good sign for the chef if you make a mess around your plate
ex.t: 如果你把盘子周围弄得一团糟，对厨师来说是好兆头

ex.s: Jeff broke two eggs into a plate and added in some milk.
ex.t: 杰夫把两个鸡蛋打进盘子里，加了一点牛奶。

ex.s: Jeff broke two eggs into a plate and added in some milk.
ex.t: 杰夫把两个鸡蛋打进盘子里，加了一点牛奶。

ex.s: Our waiter advised us to lift the plates and bowls close to our faces.
ex.t: 我们的服务员建议我们把盘子和碗举到靠近脸的地方。

ex.s: Dear Friends, We are writing this letter to call on everyone to take part in the Clear Your Plate campaign.
ex.t: 亲爱的朋友们，我们写这封信是为了呼吁所有人参加Clear Your Plate活动。

defs.def: the amount of food that you can put on a plate 一盘所盛之量；一盘
a whole main course of a meal, served on one plate 一道主菜
a thin flat piece of metal, used especially to join or make sth stronger （金属）板条，板材
a flat piece of metal with some information on it, for example sb's name （刻有名字等的）金属牌子
the pieces of metal or plastic at the front and back of a vehicle with numbers and letters on it （车辆的）号码牌
ordinary metal that is covered with a thin layer of silver or gold 镀金（或镀银）的金属
dishes, bowls, etc. that are made of silver or gold 金的（或银的）餐具
one of the thin flat pieces of horn or bone that cover and protect an animal 盾片；鳞甲；护甲
one of the very large pieces of rock that form the earth's surface and move slowly 板块

ex.t: A 地壳板块挤压在一起。

ex.s: Major tectonic plates meet at this latitude, causing earthquakes, which helped form the Himalayas.
ex.t: 主要的构造板块在这一纬度相遇，引发地震，这帮助形成了喜马拉雅山脉。

defs.def: a photograph that is used as a picture in a book, especially one that is printed on a separate page on high quality paper 书籍插图照片；（尤指优质纸上的）整页插图
a sheet of metal, plastic, etc. that has been treated so that words or pictures can be printed from it （印刷用的）印版，图版
a thin sheet of glass, metal, etc. that is covered with chemicals so that it reacts to light and can form an image, used in larger or older cameras （玻璃、金属等）底片，感光板
a thin piece of plastic with wire or artificial teeth attached to it which fits inside your mouth in order to make your teeth straight 假牙托；托牙板；假牙床
a flat dish that is used to collect money from people in a church 奉献盘；捐款盘
to cover a metal with a thin layer of another metal, especially gold or silver 电镀（尤指镀金、镀银）
to cover sth with sheets of metal or another hard substance 为 … 加设护板；（用金属板等）覆盖
